sources.scope: Initial complete app/asset checkpoint; all native phone/preview/tablet attachments and original manual phone0/25/50.

processing: Eleven retained images are byte-identical copies of their supplied native exports: seven PNGs and four small JPEGs. No image was resized, cropped, reoriented or re-encoded for retention. Other reviewed captures remain disposable originals.
pixelMetadata: Tablet PNGs encode 1640×2360; landscape orientation 8 displays 2360×1640. Both encoded and display sizes are recorded, with original orientation metadata preserved.
limits: Stills establish sampled appearance only. Native interactions and animation observations are separate evidence.
Actual VoiceOver, physical-device comfort and contrast, and browser presentation are not established by these captures.
Portrait25% has a visible but subtle root tip below the HUD; the pearl is partly obscured. Lower phone controls over pale clouds are readable on Simulator; physical contrast remains unverified.
The two original phone50% captures are Historical after b77a100; they are not retained as selected images.
Scrolled captures intentionally omit some upper or lower content. Captions describe each visible viewport rather than claiming simultaneous full-page visibility.

phone.inspectionScope: Six exported native phone still images, visually inspected with view_image. No Apple tooling was run for this inspection.
limitations: Stills do not establish animation or motion quality. Normal-motion metadata describes the test configuration only.
Actual VoiceOver and physical-device acceptance were not performed by this inspection.
The scrolled Accessibility XXXL result does not show the complete third action or upper scenic landmark; native interaction assertions are separate evidence.
phone.result: No blocking visual issue found in the six captures. Retained three byte-identical PNGs; existing evidence reports and capture indexes were not edited.

preview.inspectionScope: Six exported native phone still images: Seed Moon preview and post-Begin state over each of Lantern Landing, Ribbon Crossing and Kite Harbor. All visually inspected with view_image. No Apple tooling run for this inspection.
limitations: Stills show presentation only; preservation of prior committed state and cancellation behavior depend on the separate native assertions.
These captures do not establish animation quality, actual VoiceOver behavior or physical-device acceptance.
This evidence remains tied to a0c7360, before any proposed phone 50% artwork revision.
preview.result: No blocking visual issue found. Retained only the requested entry-over-Kite image as a byte-identical PNG; existing evidence reports and indexes were not edited.

tablet.inspectionScope: All 15 exported tablet PNGs: ten milestone scenes across portrait and landscape, plus five native-clear/rotation captures. Each visually inspected with view_image; no Apple tooling run for this inspection.
tablet.sourceContinuityNote: Parent reports subsequent b77a100/runtime dev.545382e6f6 changes only the phone 50% PNG. All tablet source images, renderer and other app/test inputs remain identical. These captures retain their actual a0c7360 source identity.
limitations: Stills do not establish animation quality; normal-motion labels describe test configuration, not observed motion.
Native hit targets, stable identity and exact geometry are separate native test assertions; still inspection supports only the visible arrangements.
Actual VoiceOver and physical-device acceptance were not performed in this inspection.
tablet.result: No blocking visual issue found. Portrait 25% is readable but subtle, with a small root tip below the HUD and the pearl partly covered. Later shoots, closed buds and open flowers are visibly distinct. Continuous sky, controls and result text remain readable. Two byte-identical images retained; existing reports/indexes untouched.
tablet.pixelMetadataNote: All exported PNGs encode 1640×2360 pixels. Portrait files use EXIF orientation 1; landscape files use EXIF orientation 8 and display at 2360×1640. Retained bytes and orientation metadata are preserved unchanged.

compact.inspectionScope: All eight exported compact Seed/Kite PNGs independently inspected with view_image; no Apple tooling run by the reviewer.
compact.result: No blocking visual issue. Closed 75% / open 100% landmarks remain distinct; headings and dialogue reflow; native-win frames show New sky and Replay fully. Other content extends beyond the tall scroll viewport as noted per capture.
limitations: Stills do not establish motion quality, native activation, actual VoiceOver or physical-device acceptance.
